# btreecap

BTree with configurable capacity limits and overflow policies.

## Crate Feature Flags

The following crate feature flags are available:

| Feature            | Default | Description           |
|--------------------|:-------:|-----------------------|
| `std`              |   Yes   | Enables `std` library |
